List all arguments used in easystats packages

Source: R/easystats_methods.R
easystats_arguments.Rd

This function returns a list with all arguments that are used across all easystats packages

Usage

easystats_arguments(
  packages = "all",
  argument = NULL,
  method = NULL,
  flatten = FALSE
)

Arguments

packages

String, name of the easystats-package, or "all" to include all packages.

argument

String, name of an argument to search for. If provided, all methods that contain this argument are returned. argument and method can be combined.

method

String, name of a method to search for. If provided, all arguments for this method (for all classes that are supported) are returned. argument and method can be combined.

flatten

If TRUE, returns only one element and each argument only once.

Value

A named list with argument names used in the different packages.

Examples

# \dontrun{
easystats_arguments()
#> $bayestestR
